steps.title: Prepare for BIS application
steps.description: Identify the applicable Indian Standard (IS 2347), confirm that the product is within its scope, and ensure that the manufacturing unit, production facilities, quality-control arrangements, testing facilities and applicable raw materials are capable of meeting the standard requirements.

steps.title: Submit BIS licence application
steps.description: Submit an application to BIS through the applicable online product certification process for a licence to use the BIS Standard Mark under Scheme-I. The application should identify the manufacturing premises, product, applicable standard and relevant manufacturing and testing details.

steps.title: Application scrutiny
steps.description: BIS scrutinizes the application and supporting information to verify completeness and applicability of the requested certification against IS 2347.

steps.title: Factory assessment
steps.description: BIS assesses the manufacturing premises to verify manufacturing capability, production controls, quality-control arrangements, testing facilities and the manufacturer's ability to consistently produce pressure cookers conforming to IS 2347.

steps.title: Product sampling and testing
steps.description: Samples of the pressure cooker are drawn and tested against the applicable requirements of IS 2347. Testing may be performed in the manufacturer's laboratory, BIS-recognized laboratory or other laboratory as permitted by the applicable BIS certification procedure.

steps.title: Close assessment non-conformities
steps.description: Where deficiencies or non-conformities are identified during assessment or testing, the manufacturer must take corrective action and provide evidence of compliance as required by BIS before the licence can be granted.

steps.title: Grant of BIS licence
steps.description: After satisfactory assessment and confirmation of product conformity, BIS grants the licence to use the BIS Standard Mark for the approved domestic pressure cooker and applicable manufacturing premises.

steps.title: Marking and labelling
steps.description: After obtaining the licence, the manufacturer marks the certified pressure cookers with the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) and other marking details required by IS 2347 and the applicable BIS licence/product manual.

steps.title: Maintain conformity and surveillance
steps.description: The licensee must continue to comply with IS 2347 and the BIS licence conditions. BIS may conduct surveillance visits, draw market or factory samples and require testing to verify continuing conformity.

steps.title: Submit BIS licence application

steps.title: Factory assessment

steps.title: Close assessment non-conformities
steps.description: Where deficiencies or non-conformities are identified during assessment or testing, the manufacturer must take corrective action and provide evidence of compliance as required by BIS before the licence can be granted.

steps.title: Grant of BIS licence

steps.description: Submit the BIS product certification application under Scheme-I, identifying the manufacturing premises, switch product, applicable ratings and the relevant product standard and certification details.

steps.title: Application scrutiny
steps.description: BIS scrutinizes the application and supporting information to verify completeness, product applicability and the proposed scope of certification against IS 3854:2023 and the applicable Product Manual requirements.

steps.title: Factory assessment
steps.description: BIS assesses the manufacturing premises to verify manufacturing capability, production controls, quality-control arrangements, inspection procedures and testing facilities required for producing switches conforming to IS 3854:2023.

steps.title: Product sampling and testing
steps.description: Samples of the switches are drawn and tested against the applicable requirements of IS 3854:2023, including the relevant construction, electrical safety, performance and environmental tests for the declared product configuration.

steps.title: Identify applicable CRS standard
steps.description: Confirm that the product is a self-ballasted LED lamp for general lighting services covered by IS 16102 (Part 1):2026 and determine the applicable lamp type, cap, rated power and voltage configuration.

steps.title: Obtain laboratory test report
steps.description: Submit representative lamp samples to a BIS-recognized laboratory having the applicable IS 16102 (Part 1) scope and obtain the prescribed test report demonstrating conformity with the safety requirements.

steps.title: Prepare CRS application
steps.description: Prepare the Compulsory Registration Scheme application with the product details, manufacturer information, applicable standard, laboratory test report and required supporting documents.

steps.title: Submit registration application
steps.description: Submit the registration application to BIS under Scheme-II along with the prescribed documentation and test evidence for the applicable IS 16102 (Part 1) requirements.

steps.title: BIS application scrutiny
steps.description: BIS reviews the application, laboratory test report and supporting information to verify completeness and conformity with the applicable CRS requirements.

steps.title: Address deficiencies
steps.description: Where deficiencies are identified in the application or test documentation, provide the required corrections, clarifications or additional evidence before registration is completed.

steps.title: Grant of BIS registration
steps.description: After satisfactory review, BIS grants the registration for the approved self-ballasted LED lamp product under Scheme-II.

steps.title: Marking and maintain conformity
steps.description: The registered product shall carry the prescribed Standard Mark and BIS registration number, and the manufacturer shall maintain continuing conformity with the applicable standard and registration conditions.

steps.title: Submit BIS licence application
steps.description: Submit the BIS product certification application under Scheme-I, identifying the manufacturing premises, toy product, primary standard, applicable secondary standards and proposed licence scope.

steps.title: Application scrutiny
steps.description: BIS scrutinizes the application and supporting information to verify product classification, applicability of the selected IS 9873 standards, completeness of the proposed licence scope and conformity-assessment requirements.

steps.title: Factory assessment
steps.description: BIS assesses the manufacturing premises to verify manufacturing capability, production controls, quality-control arrangements, inspection procedures and testing facilities needed to consistently manufacture toys conforming to the applicable requirements.

steps.title: Product sampling and testing
steps.description: Representative toy samples are drawn and tested against IS 9873 (Part 1):2025 and all applicable secondary standards identified from the toy configuration, such as Part 2 for flammability, Part 3 for migration of certain elements, Part 4 for activity toys and Part 9 for certain phthalates.

steps.title: Close assessment non-conformities
steps.description: Where deficiencies or non-conformities are identified during factory assessment or product testing, the manufacturer takes corrective action and provides the required evidence or repeat test results before certification is finalized.

steps.title: Grant of BIS licence
steps.description: After satisfactory factory assessment and confirmation of conformity with the applicable toy standards, BIS grants the licence to use the BIS Standard Mark for the approved toy products and manufacturing premises.

steps.title: Marking and labelling
steps.description: After obtaining the licence, the licensee marks the certified toys with the BIS Standard Mark and the applicable identification, manufacturer and other marking information required by the standards, Product Manual and BIS licence conditions.

steps.title: Maintain conformity and surveillance
steps.description: The licensee must maintain continuing conformity with IS 9873 (Part 1):2025 and all applicable secondary standards and BIS licence conditions. BIS may conduct surveillance, inspect manufacturing facilities and draw samples for testing to verify continued conformity.

steps.title: Submit BIS licence application
steps.description: Submit the BIS product certification application under Scheme-I, identifying the manufacturing premises, LPG cylinder product, applicable capacity range and proposed licence scope.

steps.title: Factory assessment
steps.description: BIS assesses the manufacturing premises, raw-material controls, fabrication and welding processes, inspection arrangements, quality-control procedures and testing facilities required for consistent production of conforming LPG cylinders.

steps.title: Product sampling and testing
steps.description: Representative cylinder samples are drawn and tested against the applicable requirements of IS 3196 (Part 1):2013 and the associated test methods, including relevant dimensional, material, pressure, leakage, mechanical and weld-related tests.

steps.title: Close assessment non-conformities
steps.description: Where deficiencies or non-conformities are identified during factory assessment or product testing, the manufacturer takes corrective action and provides the required evidence or repeat test results before certification is finalized.

steps.title: Grant of BIS licence

steps.title: Marking and labelling

steps.title: Maintain conformity and surveillance
steps.description: The licensee must maintain continuing conformity with IS 3196 (Part 1):2013, the Product Manual, Scheme-I requirements and applicable regulatory conditions. BIS may conduct surveillance, inspect manufacturing facilities and draw samples for testing to verify continued conformity.

steps.title: Prepare for BIS application
steps.description: Identify IS 1786:2008 as the applicable standard for high strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement, determine the applicable product form, strength grade and nominal diameter range, and ensure that the manufacturing process, raw-material controls, inspection arrangements and testing facilities meet the Product Manual requirements.

steps.title: Submit BIS licence application

steps.title: Factory assessment

steps.title: Close assessment non-conformities
steps.description: Where deficiencies or non-conformities are identified during factory assessment or product testing, the manufacturer takes corrective action and provides the required evidence or repeat test results before certification is finalized.

steps.title: Grant of BIS licence

steps.title: Marking and labelling

steps.title: Maintain conformity and surveillance

BIS may conduct surveillance, inspect manufacturing facilities and draw samples for testing to verify continued conformity.

steps.title: Marking and maintain conformity

steps.description: Mark the certified PPC in accordance with the marking and labelling requirements of IS 1489 (Part 1):2015, the product manual and applicable BIS licence conditions.

steps.title: Maintain conformity and surveillance
steps.description: Continue to comply with IS 1489 (Part 1):2015 and BIS licence conditions, including applicable surveillance, sampling and testing requirements for maintaining continuing conformity.

steps.title: Identify applicable PPC standard and variant
steps.description: Identify IS 1489 (Part 2):2015 as the applicable standard for Portland Pozzolana Cement using calcined clay, and confirm that the product and manufacturing process fall within the standard scope.

steps.title: Prepare BIS licence application
steps.description: Prepare the manufacturing, quality-control, testing and product information required for applying for a BIS licence under Scheme-I for Portland Pozzolana Cement covered by IS 1489 (Part 2):2015.

steps.title: Submit BIS application
steps.description: Submit the applicable BIS product certification application identifying the manufacturing premises, Portland Pozzolana Cement product, applicable standard and relevant production and testing details.

steps.title: Factory assessment
steps.description: BIS assesses the manufacturing premises, production controls, quality-control arrangements and testing facilities to verify the capability to consistently manufacture PPC conforming to IS 1489 (Part 2):2015.

steps.title: Product sampling and testing
steps.description: Samples are drawn and tested against the applicable chemical and physical requirements of IS 1489 (Part 2):2015.

steps.title: Close non-conformities
steps.description: Address any deficiencies or test non-conformities identified during assessment or product testing and provide corrective-action evidence as required by BIS.

steps.title: Grant of BIS licence
steps.description: Upon satisfactory assessment and confirmation of conformity, BIS grants the licence to use the Standard Mark for the approved PPC manufactured at the assessed premises.

steps.title: Marking and labelling
steps.description: Mark the certified PPC in accordance with the marking and labelling requirements of IS 1489 (Part 2):2015, the product manual and applicable BIS licence conditions.

steps.title: Maintain conformity and surveillance
steps.description: Continue to comply with IS 1489 (Part 2):2015 and BIS licence conditions, including applicable surveillance, sampling and testing requirements for maintaining continuing conformity.

steps.title: Identify applicable refrigerator requirements
steps.description: Identify IS 17550 (Part 1):2024 as the applicable general-requirements standard for the household refrigerating appliance and confirm that the refrigerator configuration falls within its scope.

steps.title: Prepare BIS licence application
steps.description: Prepare the manufacturing, product, quality-control, testing and marking information required for application for a BIS licence under Scheme-I for the household refrigerating appliance.

steps.title: Submit BIS application
steps.description: Submit the applicable BIS product certification application identifying the manufacturing premises, refrigerator model or product range, applicable IS 17550 requirements and relevant production and testing details.

steps.title: Application scrutiny and factory assessment
steps.description: BIS scrutinizes the application and assesses the manufacturing premises, production controls, quality-control arrangements and testing facilities for the applicant's ability to consistently manufacture conforming household refrigerating appliances.

steps.title: Product sampling and testing
steps.description: Samples are drawn and tested against the applicable requirements of IS 17550 (Part 1):2024 and the other applicable parts of the IS 17550 series, including relevant safety and performance requirements.

steps.title: Close non-conformities
steps.description: Address deficiencies or non-conformities identified during factory assessment or product testing and provide corrective-action evidence as required by BIS.

steps.title: Grant of BIS licence
steps.description: After satisfactory assessment and confirmation of conformity, BIS grants the licence to use the BIS Standard Mark for the approved household refrigerating appliance and manufacturing premises.

steps.title: Marking and labelling
steps.description: Mark the certified refrigerator in accordance with the applicable IS 17550 marking requirements, product manual provisions and BIS licence conditions.

steps.title: Maintain conformity and surveillance
steps.description: Continue to comply with the applicable IS 17550 requirements, product manual and BIS licence conditions, including applicable inspection, surveillance, sampling and testing requirements for maintaining continuing conformity.

steps.title: Identify applicable performance requirements
steps.description: Identify IS 17550 (Part 2):2024 as the applicable performance-requirements standard for the household refrigerating appliance and confirm the refrigerator configuration is within scope.

steps.title: Prepare BIS certification information
steps.description: Ensure the product, manufacturing, quality-control and testing information needed to demonstrate conformity with the applicable IS 17550 performance requirements is available.

steps.title: Submit BIS application
steps.description: Include the applicable performance requirements of IS 17550 (Part 2):2024 within the BIS product certification application for the refrigerator.

steps.title: Factory assessment
steps.description: BIS verifies the manufacturing and quality-control arrangements relevant to consistent refrigerator performance and conformity with the applicable standard requirements.

steps.title: Performance testing
steps.description: Samples are tested against the applicable performance requirements of IS 17550 (Part 2):2024.

steps.title: Close non-conformities
steps.description: Address any identified non-conformities and provide corrective-action evidence as required by BIS.

steps.title: Maintain conformity under licence
steps.description: Maintain conformity with the applicable IS 17550 performance requirements and BIS licence conditions following successful certification.

steps.title: Marking and labelling
steps.description: Apply the applicable BIS Standard Mark and required product information in accordance with the product manual and licence conditions.

steps.title: Surveillance and continuing compliance
steps.description: Continue applicable BIS surveillance, sampling and testing activities to demonstrate ongoing conformity with the IS 17550 requirements.

steps.title: Identify energy and volume requirements
steps.description: Identify IS 17550 (Part 3):2025 as the applicable standard for determination of energy consumption and volume for the household refrigerating appliance.

steps.title: Prepare energy and volume data
steps.description: Ensure the refrigerator model information, rated characteristics and testing arrangements necessary for determination of energy consumption and volume are available.

steps.title: Include applicable requirements in BIS certification
steps.description: Include the applicable IS 17550 (Part 3):2025 energy-consumption and volume requirements within the BIS certification framework for the refrigerator.

steps.title: Verify testing capability
steps.description: Verify that the manufacturer or applicable testing facility has the capability to perform the energy-consumption and volume determinations required by the standard.

steps.title: Energy and volume testing
steps.description: Test the refrigerator using the applicable methods specified in IS 17550 (Part 3):2025 for energy consumption and volume determination.

steps.title: Close non-conformities
steps.description: Address any deviations identified from the applicable energy-consumption or volume requirements and provide corrective-action evidence as required.

steps.title: Confirm conformity
steps.description: Use satisfactory test results and the applicable BIS certification assessment to confirm conformity with the relevant IS 17550 requirements.

steps.title: Marking and product information
steps.description: Provide the required BIS Standard Mark and applicable product information in accordance with the relevant certification and marking requirements.

steps.title: Maintain continuing compliance
steps.description: Maintain conformity with IS 17550 (Part 3):2025 and applicable BIS licence conditions, including continuing testing, inspection and surveillance requirements.

steps.title: Identify applicable safety-footwear requirements
steps.description: Identify IS 15298 (Part 2):2024 as the applicable standard for the safety footwear and confirm the footwear class, design, size range and protection characteristics fall within the standard and applicable certification grouping.

steps.title: Prepare BIS licence application
steps.description: Prepare the manufacturing, product, quality-control, testing and marking information required for application for a BIS licence under Scheme-I for safety footwear.

steps.title: Submit BIS application
steps.description: Submit the applicable BIS product certification application identifying the manufacturing premises, safety-footwear varieties and sizes, applicable standard and relevant production and testing details.

steps.title: Application scrutiny and factory assessment
steps.description: BIS scrutinizes the application and assesses the manufacturing premises, production controls, quality-control arrangements and testing facilities relevant to consistent manufacture of conforming safety footwear.

steps.title: Product sampling and testing
steps.description: Samples are drawn according to the applicable grouping and sampling provisions and tested against the relevant requirements of IS 15298 (Part 2):2024, including applicable basic and additional protection requirements.

steps.title: Close non-conformities
steps.description: Address deficiencies or test non-conformities identified during factory assessment or product testing and provide corrective-action evidence as required by BIS.

steps.title: Grant of BIS licence
steps.description: After satisfactory assessment and confirmation of conformity, BIS grants the licence to use the BIS Standard Mark for the approved safety-footwear varieties and manufacturing premises.

steps.title: Marking and labelling
steps.description: Mark the certified safety footwear with the required BIS Standard Mark and applicable product information in accordance with IS 15298 (Part 2):2024, the Product Manual and BIS licence conditions.

steps.title: Maintain conformity and surveillance
steps.description: Continue to comply with IS 15298 (Part 2):2024, the Product Manual and BIS licence conditions, including applicable inspection, surveillance, sampling and testing requirements for maintaining continuing conformity.
